For small angular displacements, the time period of a simple pendulum of length $l$ under gravity $g$ is:

$$T = 2\pi \sqrt{\frac{l}{g}}$$

Dimensionally, $[l/g] = \text{m} / (\text{m/s}^2) = \text{s}^2$, so $\sqrt{l/g}$ has units of seconds, matching period $T$.
